migration_policy_MIG-POLICY-2026.content: Migration Policy MIG-POLICY-2026 (owner: Support Ops, v3, effective 2026-06-01). Eligibility: MOVE tickets with status in {open, pending} created within last 90 days. EXCLUDE tickets tagged 'spam' or 'duplicate'. EXCLUDE tickets tagged 'sales' or 'quote' (handled by CRM team, not Freshdesk). Field mapping: Gorgias status open->Freshdesk 'Open', pending->'Pending'; priority low/normal/high->1/2/3; Gorgias tags->Freshdesk tags verbatim; last_agent->Freshdesk responder if name matches active roster else unassigned. Tickets flagged 'needs manual decision' if requester domain is on the partner list or if mapping is ambiguous.

migration_log_MIGLOG-2026.content: Migration Log MIGLOG-2026 (worksheet 'Migrated'). Header row: gorgias_id | freshdesk_id | migrated_at | migrated_by | status_mapped | notes. Current rows: none yet (migration not started). This is the authoritative audit record; one row per ticket actually created in Freshdesk.
